parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The application name. The name must be 2 to 16 characters in length.

parameters.name: AuditType
parameters.description:
The security audit mode. Valid values:
- 0: default value. Security audit is disabled.
- 1: Built-in security audit.
- 2: Custom security audit.

parameters.name: AuditUrl
parameters.description: The URL for custom security audit. This parameter is required when custom security audit is selected (AuditType=2). The URL must start with http:// or https://, must not contain private IP addresses, and must not include port numbers. For the format of custom security audit content, see the following section.

parameters.name: DataCenter
parameters.description:
The data center. Valid values:
- cn-shanghai: default value. Shanghai.
- ap-southeast-1: Singapore.

> When calling other interactive messaging API operations, the data center must be the same as the one used to create the interactive messaging application.

parameters.name: EventCallbackUrl
parameters.description: The event callback URL for client logon, logout, join group, and leave group events. If this parameter is empty, event callbacks are disabled. For the API operations that trigger callbacks, see [Client access](~~2672836~~). The event callback URL must start with http:// or https://, must not contain private IP addresses, and must not include port numbers. For the event callback format and callback authentication logic, see the following section.

parameters.name: MsgLifeCycle
parameters.description:
The storage duration tier for group messages within the application. Valid values:
- 0: default value. Messages are stored for 30 days.
- 1: Messages are stored for 90 days.
- 2: Messages are stored for 180 days.
